integrity: Two independent counting expressions, a general proof, and a direct finite checker are supplied; computational cases do not certify an infinite theorem or novelty.
scientific_limitations: Full texts of two earlier semigroup papers were inaccessible; existence of implicit equivalent expressions elsewhere is not excluded. Limit covers rank densities strictly between zero and one; no boundary limits or fluctuation theorem asserted.
title: Complete product-rank spectrum and asymmetric limits for partial idempotents
